name: MegaMan's own sprite
why: MegaMan is drawn from each game's own sprite (BN5's at 0x081C9800, BN6's at 0x081D8000, his sprite state's +0x18 less 4 in each trace), whose frames, their order and their durations differ; the same for what he owns (his buster's charge glow, sprite list 5's 8 in each game). The animation his code picks (+0x00), his palette (+0x04) and the sprite itself (+0x18, by maps' sprites registry) are compared; what his sprite makes of it is not his logic nor the family's. Masked for his own object only while he is not united in both games: united, both draw him from BN5's sprite of the Soul (BN6's a copy of it in the grown list 0, src/emu/soullook.c), whose frames are compared.
evidence: his sprite state's data pointer: BN5 0x081C9804, BN6 0x081D8004 at t1; his frame (+0x01) runs 1 against 4 from t101 in spec cangard_v1
the charge glow's sprite: BN5's list 5 entry at 0x08032B2C, BN6's at 0x08032134 (each naming its own data)
